notes.title: Volatica: The Devil's Trap has been selected on Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
Dear Witches and Wizards!

We are happy to announce, that  Volatica: The Devil's Trap has been selected to be on DreamHack Beyond Indie Showcase!

 Event Starts: Oct. 14, 2022 at 12:01 AM EDT
 Event Ends: Oct. 23, 2022 at 11:59 PM EDT
So remember to check the #DHBIndies from October 14th!
